episode_notes:
Scenes and Plot Structure:
- L0002-L0014: Teaser hook of Soham pleading for clarity about Hansini's past.
- L0015-L0028: Himalaya Neem face wash advertisement (skip).
- L0029-L0061: Soham calls Keerthi desperate to meet Hansini after being blocked; Keerthi arranges a meeting.
- L0062-L0119: Bitter roadside confrontation where Hansini refuses to speak to Soham, says she was cheated, and leaves after five minutes.
- L0120-L0136: Flashback/hospital context where Hansini previously saw Soham with a woman and child, assuming he maintained a secret family.
- L0137-L0157: Aravind learns Hansini broke up with Soham and resolves to support and pursue her.
- L0158-L0246: Mother (Paddu) and Hansini at home; mom humorously introduces wine drinking and insists they be friends ('Call me Paddu').
- L0247-L0306: Mother and daughter have an emotional talk on companionship. Hansini asks if her mom will be lonely if she marries; mom lovingly replies that the right man will be a son to her.
- L0307-L0407: Aravind arrives nervously to apologize to Paddu; Paddu shocks him by being ultra-chill, supporting his love, and offering an 'All the best'.
- L0408-L0464: Lake climax. Aravind confronts Hansini and insults Soham. Hansini explodes and reveals the episode's tragic twist: Soham didn't cheat—he passed away (L0461).

discovery.payoff: Hansini coldly declaring that his five minutes are over and dismissing him: 'నువ్ ఇచ్చిన five minutes time అయిపోయింది. ఇంక నువ్వు వెళ్ళొచ్చు.'

review.cold_open_note: The cold open line is a generic breakup statement. Starting directly with the guy asking why she has been torturing him for a week creates a far more compelling hook.
